evidence: Directly refactors ArgsManager in src/common/args.cpp and src/common/args.h, adding the ALLOW_LIST flag and runtime enforcement.
rationale: Enforces safe multi-value argument access patterns across the entire codebase to prevent silent bugs. The PR description notes that calling single-argument accessors on list options causes subtle errors like ignoring values or misinterpreting negated options, and this establishes a durable invariant while unblocking dependent work.
